title: Gwada lafiya, kiyaye maɓallan ku, shirya don gazawa

say: Gwada lafiya, kiyaye maɓallan ku, kuma ku tsara gazawa.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module biyu na API Fundamentals.

Mashigin adireshi na burauza zai iya aika buƙatun GET kawai, kuma yana ɓoye masu kai. Don gwada ainihin APIs kuna buƙatar abokin ciniki API, kayan aiki inda kuka zaɓi hanyar, URL, masu kai da jiki, kuma ku ga cikakkiyar amsa.

say: Yawancin ɗalibai suna farawa da Hoppscotch akan waya. Yana da kyauta kuma haske akan bayanai.

panel.heading: Hoppscotch ko Postman?
left: Yana gudana a kowace mashigar bincike, har ma da waya
right: Yana adana tarin abubuwa, rabawa tare da ƙungiya
Babban zazzagewa akan bayanan wayar hannu

say: Ma'aikacin gidan waya ya dace da tarin da aka adana da ƙungiyoyi akan kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka.
Hakanan koyi karanta curl, saboda yawancin takaddun suna nuna misalai ta wannan hanyar. Dash H yana ƙara kan kai, dash d shine jiki, kuma dash X yana saita hanya.
Kwarewa akan APIs na karya kamar JSONPlaceholder, wanda kawai yayi kamar yana ajiyewa. Kada a taɓa yin gwaji tare da DELETE akan asusun kasuwanci na gaske.

say: Kyakkyawan takaddun suna amsa tambayoyin iri ɗaya kowane lokaci. Nemo tushen URL, inda kowane ƙarshen ƙarshen zai fara. Sannan yadda zaku tabbatar da wanene ku. Yawancin APIs suna ɗaukar maɓalli a cikin taken izini azaman alamar mai ɗaukar hoto.

Tsallake takaddun ko matakin gwajin shine inda yawancin haɗin gwiwar da suka gaza farawa.

panel.rule: Bincika adadin da kuɗi, ba kawai kalmar nasara ba.

say: Maɓalli na sirri na iya aiki akan dukkan asusun, gami da kuɗi. Ajiye shi akan uwar garken kawai, kar a taɓa saukewa cikin masu amfani da lambar app. Kar a taɓa aika shi akan WhatsApp ko imel, ko liƙa shi cikin tattaunawar AI, hotunan kariyar kwamfuta ko takaddun da aka raba. Tsare shi daga GitHub.
Idan maɓalli na iya yabo, haifar da sabo lokaci guda, wanda ke dakatar da tsohon yana aiki.

panel.heading: Bi da maɓallin sirri kamar PIN na banki
items: Ajiye shi a gefen uwar garken kawai
Kada a taɓa yin hira ta WhatsApp, imel ko AI
Kar a taɓa cikin hotunan kariyar kwamfuta ko takaddun da aka raba
Ka kiyaye shi daga lamba akan GitHub
Idan maiyuwa ne ya leka, samar da sabo

say: Na farko, iyakoki. A 429 yana nufin buƙatun da yawa. Jira muddin rubutun na sake gwadawa ya ce. Don kurakuran uwar garken wucin gadi, jira kuma ninka jira kowane lokaci. Kada a sake gwada POST ta atomatik da ke motsa kuɗi.

say: APIs suna canzawa, maɓallai sun ƙare, kuma maginin yana ci gaba. Wani ɗan gajeren takardar gudu yana barin wani ya ci gaba da aiki. Yi rikodin buƙatun kasuwanci, mai shi, da ainihin shafukan takaddun bayanai.

panel.heading: Fayil ɗin tafiyar da API
items: Manufar da mai shi
Mai bayarwa, URL tushe da hanyoyin haɗin yanar gizo
Wuraren ƙarewa, filayen da raka'a
Inda aka adana maɓallai, ba maɓallan ba
Kurakurai, iyaka, gwaji da lambobin sadarwa

say: Lissafin kowane ƙarshen ƙarshen tare da raka'a. Yi rikodin inda aka adana maɓallai da wanda zai iya samun dama gare su, amma ba maɓallan da kansu ba.

say: Yanzu gudanar da yin rikodin buƙatun ayyuka huɗu, rubuta takardar gaskiyar API shafi ɗaya, kuma rubuta shirin gwaji da takardar gudu.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
